responsesWS.label: OpenAI Responses WebSocket
responsesWS.description: Opt-in upstream WebSocket for client WebSocket /v1/responses ingress. "Enabled · Default off" turns the capability on without using it by default (channels can opt in); Passthrough/Transform is the default mode unless overridden per channel.

sseHeartbeat.label: SSE Heartbeat Interval (seconds)
sseHeartbeat.description: Applies to both the in-stream heartbeat interval and the first heartbeat delay before the upstream stream is established; 0 disables. 30-60 seconds is recommended behind Cloudflare.
sseHeartbeat.compatibility: Some clients may mishandle SSE comments, so disable it if compatibility issues occur.

groupHealth.label: Group Health Checks
groupHealth.description: When enabled, show the home health summary, group-card health status, and allow manual health checks.

circuitBreaker.title: Circuit Breaker
circuitBreaker.hint: When a channel fails consecutively up to the threshold, circuit breaker trips. Cooldown grows exponentially up to the max cooldown

usageRetention.title: Usage Analytics
usageRetention.label: Hourly Aggregate Retention (days)
usageRetention.description: How long hourly usage aggregates remain available for analytics.

outlierRetirement.title: Passive Outlier Retirement
outlierRetirement.hint: Temporarily disables site projected channels that keep failing on real requests (disabled, never deleted), then probes them periodically and re-enables them once they recover. Before disabling, sibling channels of the same site are cross-checked and a probe request confirms the failure to avoid false positives; at least one enabled channel is always kept per account. Applies only to site projected channels. Off by default.

interval.label: Evaluation Interval (minutes)
interval.description: How often the background task runs one round of evaluation and recovery probing.

failRate.label: Failure Rate Threshold (%)
failRate.description: A channel is considered abnormal only when the failure ratio within the window reaches this value.

minSamples.label: Minimum Samples
minSamples.description: Evaluation is skipped while the window holds fewer requests than this, avoiding misjudgment on sparse traffic.

consecFails.label: Consecutive Failure Threshold
consecFails.description: After the failure rate is met, the most recent consecutive failures must also reach this count (or the window has no success at all).

windowMinutes.label: Rolling Window Duration (minutes)
windowMinutes.description: Only requests within this recent period are counted; older records expire automatically.

windowCapacity.label: Window Sample Capacity (≤20)
windowCapacity.description: Maximum number of request records kept per window; the oldest are dropped first.

recoverStreak.label: Probe Successes to Recover
recoverStreak.description: A retired channel is re-enabled after this many consecutive successful probes.

reapMinutes.label: Idle Window Reap (minutes)
reapMinutes.description: Frees a channel's in-memory stats window after it has received no new requests for this long.

cfRecoverMinutes.label: Cloudflare Recovery Cooldown (minutes)
cfRecoverMinutes.description: Channels retired due to Cloudflare protection wait this long before recovery probing starts, to reduce pointless probes.
